llm.summary: This skill is mainly a hosting tool, but it also stores account credentials locally and includes broader private Drive and account-management powers that users should review first.

dimensions.detail: Network calls, curl, jq, file inspection, and local file uploads are expected for publishing and Drive storage, but directory publishing/import can transmit selected local content to here.now and relies on upload/finalize URLs returned by the service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install path is disclosed as an npx-based skill install with global and project-local options; no hidden install-time persistence was found in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Most operations are user-directed, and destructive Drive actions require confirmation, but the skill directs agents to consult live docs/API for broad management capabilities and includes fairly broad activation language such as generating URLs and putting content online.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs the agent to save a long-lived API key in ~/.herenow/credentials and stores anonymous claim tokens in .herenow/state.json; this is disclosed and chmod-protected, but it materially increases credential and account impact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Publishing sites, files, workspace URLs, and access controls fit the stated hosting purpose, but private Drive storage, Drive token sharing, and broader account/Site management extend beyond the top-level publishing-focused description.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing if you do not want agents to store a here.now API key, upload local files, manage private Drive contents, create scoped sharing tokens, or perform broader site/account operations. Use project-local installation when possible, keep ~/.herenow/credentials out of source control, and only publish or import folders you have checked for private files.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Network and shell helper usage is disclosed in requirements and is coherent with publishing/upload workflows, though explicit permission scoping is limited.
[TP4] unexpected: The Drive and broader management features are documented in the body, but they are not reflected in the top-level publishing-oriented description, supporting a Review concern for under-disclosure.
[SDI-2] expected: Persisting an API key supports permanent authenticated publishing, but the instruction to save it locally by default is a real credential-persistence risk.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Private Drive storage, sharing tokens, import/export, and deletion are substantial capabilities beyond a simple web-publishing workflow, even though the Drive section itself describes them.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger examples mostly refer to web publishing or site sharing; the scanner's plain 'share this' concern is overstated, but 'generate a URL' and similar phrases remain broad enough to warrant care before uploading content.
[E1] expected: Uploading local files to a server-provided uploadUrl is expected for signed upload flows, but the script does not independently validate the returned upload host.
[E1] expected: Posting to a server-provided finalizeUrl is part of the publish flow, but sending authorization headers to that returned URL without host validation is a hardening gap rather than evidence of malicious intent.
